blocks.text: Google AI Studio
Free IDE for building AI-powered apps with Gemini
Overview

Google AI Studio gives developers a free, browser-based environment to build AI-powered applications using Google's Gemini models. Prototype prompts, test with different models, and deploy to Cloud Run - all without leaving the browser or managing infrastructure.

The multimodal capabilities of Gemini are immediately accessible in AI Studio. Upload images, audio, or video alongside text prompts to build applications that understand multiple types of input. For developers exploring multimodal AI use cases, the experimentation cycle is nearly frictionless.

For teams already using Google Cloud, AI Studio integrates naturally with the existing ecosystem. Models deployed from AI Studio can connect to Cloud Functions, Firestore, BigQuery, and other GCP services - extending AI capabilities across your infrastructure.
Key Features
Free Prototyping
Test prompts and build AI applications at no cost
Gemini Models
Access to Google's latest Gemini models for text, image, and video
Multimodal Input
Process text, images, audio, and video in the same prompt
One-Click Deploy
Deploy applications directly to Google Cloud Run
API Key Generation
Get API keys for integrating Gemini into your own applications
Prompt Testing
Compare model outputs and tune parameters interactively
Why We Recommend Google AI Studio
AI Studio is the fastest way to prototype AI features using Gemini. The free tier is generous for development, and the one-click deployment to Cloud Run removes DevOps friction entirely.
